release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.1.0

This is the stable public release.

New computers use LockStepPDF_4.1.0_Setup.exe. That setup installs the program, Labels, and Tesseract. The languages are eng, spa, fra, and deu. LibreOffice is installed beside the program, so Word, PowerPoint, and Excel convert on a new computer.

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice. Tesseract and Labels are inside the program folder.

Mail Merge preview for a multi-page template with Every page follows the Real Time Monitor, so each following sheet keeps its own record. Bottom-aligned text keeps the tails of letters such as g, j, p, q, and y. A field can be an Image or PDF from a local or UNC path, and an HTML field can draw a local image.

Export Proofs writes a proof of the pages you choose. Monitor is the compiled preview. Selection is the highlighted pages. Tree is every page in the asset list. PDF is one file. PNG and JPG are one picture per page.

Fold type starts at None. Pick a fold to draw fold lines on the proof. Blank sheet, fold lines only writes the guides with no artwork.

A stamp is optional. The words start as DIGITAL PROOF. Choose a color and an opacity from 10 to 100.

Build & Save no longer stamps the production file.
